g.text: Entry points
Core
State
External
trunk build to dist/ · cargo tauri dev for a desktop run, bundle for installers
src/main.rs · mounts the Leptos App, csr feature, everything runs in WASM
src/app.rs 3300 lines · the shell state machine, vault, tabs, editor and menus
editor_core.rs · CM6-style state plus transaction kernel, 584 lines
markdown_syntax.rs 1850 lines · live styling grammar over the raw text
sidebar_panel.rs + sidebar_tree.rs · vault tree, context menu, label colors
metadata_sidebar.rs · headings, tags, links, backlinks and unlinked mentions
vault_tabs.rs + recent_notes_pane.rs · several vaults open at once
tauri_bridge.rs · the only door into Rust, 24 invoke calls with typed args
src-tauri/src/lib.rs · read, write, rename with wiki-link rewrite, vault import, pickers
src-tauri/src/session.rs · vault session and recent-note cache
the vault itself · plain .md files, no database and no index on disk
.bedrock/ per vault · vault-session.json, recent.json, obsidian-file-color data
settings.json plus .plugins/*.css per vault · theme variables and plugin CSS
WebView2, WKWebView or WebKitGTK · renders the WASM bundle
native file dialogs · vault picker and Obsidian vault import
an Obsidian vault on disk · notes, images and obsidian-file-color data.json
